Class AetherisYaml

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.config.AetherisYaml
public class AetherisYaml extends Object
The AetherisYaml class loads aetheris.yaml and holds the values the shell reads. The file uses spaces for indent. A tab in the file makes the load throw IllegalStateException. A key this class does not recognize is ignored. The class does not use SnakeYAML. // @aa-sdd G-03 G-20 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md The load(String[]) method looks for a file in a fixed order. The first place is the path after --aetheris-yaml. The second place is aetheris.yaml in the working directory. The third place is .aetheris.yaml in the home directory. A missing file leaves the defaults from the constructor. ensureHomeFile() writes that home file when it is absent. An existing home file is left as it stands.

  • Constructor Details

    • AetherisYaml

      public AetherisYaml()
      The constructor stores the defaults used when no file is present. The title is Aetheris Shell. The vault mode is disk. The vault path is empty. The pool maximum is 4. The air-gap flag is false and is not yet known from a file. The AMWP flag starts enabled. AMWP is the framed protocol on the connection. The mood-shape id is empty. The burner-key flag is false.

    • grokDoor

      public static boolean grokDoor(String provider, boolean modelPresent, boolean burner, String word)
      The grokDoor method reports whether this Grok case skips the air-gap refusal. The provider token must be grok. Text must follow the slash, so modelPresent is true. The burner flag must be false. A burner is an ephemeral request. The word must be exactly true. The word unset returns false. The word false returns false. Any other provider returns false. The method does not write the word. A false result leaves the caller on refusesCloud(). The notebook and AmwpFacade both call this method.
      Parameters:
      provider - The provider is the token before /.
      modelPresent - The flag is true when text follows /.
      burner - The flag is true for an ephemeral request, and true does not skip the refusal.
      word - The word is true, false, or unset.
      Returns:
      The return value is true only for that one Grok case.

    • poolDoor

      public static boolean poolDoor(String provider, boolean burner, String word)
      The poolDoor method reports whether this pool case skips the air-gap refusal. The provider token must be pool. The method does not require a model id. The burner flag must be false. The word must be exactly true. The word unset returns false. The word false returns false. The method does not write the word.
      Parameters:
      provider - The provider is the token before /.
      burner - The flag is true for an ephemeral request, and true does not skip the refusal.
      word - The word is true, false, or unset.
      Returns:
      The return value is true only for that pool case.

    • burnerCloudAllowed

      public boolean burnerCloudAllowed()
      The method reports whether a burner may use a cloud target. A burner is an ephemeral request. The value comes from notebook.burner-key. A missing key leaves the flag false. A line that does not start with burner-key: is ignored. The words true, yes, and 1 set the flag. The flag is not the Grok API key. refusesCloud() still refuses a cloud target on its own.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when the file allows the burner hop.

    • moodShapeId

      public String moodShapeId()
      The method returns the shaper id from notebook.mood-shape. A line that does not start with mood-shape: is ignored. A missing key returns an empty string. A null field also returns an empty string. An empty id means the Ollama model already in use.
      Returns:
      The return value is the id, or empty when the key is absent.

    • readProcessHome

      public static AetherisYaml readProcessHome()
      The method reads .aetheris.yaml from the process user's home directory. This path is the server copy. It is not the lookup load(String[]) uses for the shell. A missing file returns a new object with the constructor defaults. A present file is parsed by readFile(File).
      Returns:
      The return value is the parsed file, or the defaults when the file is missing.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - The method throws this when the file contains a tab.

    • ensureHomeFile

      public static void ensureHomeFile()
      The method writes .aetheris.yaml in the home directory when that file is absent. An existing file is left as it stands. The bytes are HOME_DEFAULTS. network.air-gap in that text is explicit true. The method does not copy a repository file. The method does not copy an install-folder file. A file created by another start is left as it stands. A write error prints Unable to write plus the path and the exception message. readProcessHome() still reads this path.

    • load

      public static AetherisYaml load(String[] args)
      The method loads the shell file from the first path that exists. The first path is the file named after --aetheris-yaml when that flag is present and the file exists. The second path is aetheris.yaml in the working directory. The third path is .aetheris.yaml in the home directory. A null argument array skips the flag and continues with the two files. A missing file at every path returns the constructor defaults.
      Parameters:
      args - The array is the main argument list, and it may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the loaded file, or the defaults when no file exists.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - The method throws this when the chosen file contains a tab.

      Returns:

    • readFile

      static AetherisYaml readFile(File file)
      The method parses one aetheris.yaml file. A line that contains a tab throws IllegalStateException. The exception message names the absolute path. A blank line is skipped. A line whose trimmed text starts with # is skipped. Keys are read only under a top-level aetheris: line. Another top-level key turns that section off. A line indented two spaces that ends with : and contains no space is a section name. The known section names are ui, vault, network, amwp, and notebook. A key line is indented at least four spaces. A line indented less than four spaces, and not a section, is skipped. An unknown key is ignored. An IOException while reading returns a new object with the constructor defaults. That failure discards any keys already applied.
      Parameters:
      file - The file is the yaml file to read.
      Returns:
      The return value is the parsed object, or the defaults when the read fails.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - The method throws this when a line contains a tab.

    • applyKey

      private static void applyKey(AetherisYaml yaml, String section, String trimmed)
      The method applies one known key in the current section. ui.title is stored through setTitle(String). vault.mode ram stores ram. Any other vault mode stores disk. vault.path stores the unquoted path. vault.pool-max stores the integer. A pool maximum that is not an integer stores 4. A pool maximum below 1 stores 1. network.air-gap marks the flag known and stores the boolean. amwp.enabled stores the boolean. notebook.mood-shape stores the unquoted id. notebook.burner-key stores the boolean. Any other line is ignored.
      Parameters:
      yaml - The yaml object receives the value.
      section - The section is the current two-space name.
      trimmed - The trimmed line is the key line with its indent removed.

    • parseBool

      private static boolean parseBool(String raw)
      The method reads a boolean token. true and yes match in any letter case. The token 1 matches only that exact character. Any other token returns false.
      Parameters:
      raw - The raw value is the text after the colon.
      Returns:
      The return value is true for true, yes, or 1.

    • unquote

      private static String unquote(String value)
      The method strips one pair of double quotes from a value. The quotes are removed only when the value starts and ends with " and has length at least 2. Any other value is returned unchanged. Escape sequences are not decoded.
      Parameters:
      value - The value is the text after the colon.
      Returns:
      The return value is the value with that one pair removed, or the original text.

    • indentOf

      private static int indentOf(String line)
      The method counts the leading spaces on a line. A tab is not counted as indent.
      Parameters:
      line - The line is one file line, including its leading spaces.
      Returns:
      The return value is the number of leading spaces.
